style: Cinematic hand-painted 2D anime drama, grounded anatomy, fine expressive linework, textured painted backgrounds, restrained facial performance, 16:9 landscape. Worn mudbrick, timber, reed mats, coarse woven cloth and clay vessels. Keep the approved character faces, wardrobe, prop placement and screen direction from the first frame.

locations.LANDING_DAY: Pethor main low landing on river-left bank looking downstream; fixed timber post at shore, low wooden ferry at waterline, bend upstream to screen left.
locations.HOUSE: Beor's mudbrick home; bench on right wall, table center-left, river-facing door behind camera-left, single clay lamp on table.
locations.HOUSE_NIGHT: Same Beor house at night; bench, table and door retain their positions.
locations.HOUSE_DAY: Same house in daylight; the queue waits outside the river-facing doorway.
locations.HOUSE_EVENING: Same house at evening; open door provides a line toward river and lane.
locations.HOUSE_RAIN: Same house during rain, repaired beams visible above dry living space.
locations.HOUSE_LATER: Same house across later seasons; stable doorway and table allow time-match cuts.
locations.RIDGE_NIGHT: Old upper landing on river-left bank downstream of settlement bend; post above sheltered inlet, stone stairs descend to inlet. Keep current left-to-right in river-facing shots.
locations.RIDGE_DAWN: Same old ridge, post, inlet and staircase at dawn.
locations.RIDGE_EVENING: Same ridge at sunset. Clay puppy may stand beside lamp after episode 3.
locations.INLET_NIGHT: Sheltered inlet directly below old post; staircase on near left, channel current beyond, family boat approaches from upstream left.

locations.MARKET_LATER: Same Pethor market after wall repair, with caravan unloading area beyond.
locations.LANDING_WINTER: Same low landing in winter; clothing is arranged on dry high stones above spray.
locations.CITY_FIRE: Fictional distant city, workshop alley leading toward gate; exterior stair beside workshop and child hidden beneath.
locations.CITY_SQUARE: Open square safely beyond workshop fire, water jars near exit, path back to alley visible.
locations.RIVER_DRY: High stone ledge near Pethor with a basket landmark, path to high ground on left bank.
locations.LANDING_FLOOD: Same Pethor landing and upper path during rising river; animals and families move uphill away from current.

locations.MEADOW_DUSK: Same meadow and gate at dusk after public transfer.
locations.FIELD: Field sister's animal shelter, gate near left, empty trough center, path toward distant grazing beyond.
locations.PETHOR_LATER: Older Pethor with stable river and ridge landmarks, repaired homes and mature planted tree beside main lane.

locations.ISRAEL_DUSK: Same family lane at dusk, single lamp outside brothers' tent and meeting place farther along.

locations.MOAB_GATE: Moabite city gate with shaded side chamber; king receives travelers inside entrance.

locations.ROAD_NARROW: Narrow rocky pass with no side exit; donkey and angel share same path axis.
locations.MOAB_GUEST: Balaam's Moab guest room, familiar travel lamp and bedroll, door toward envoy's quarters.
locations.OVERLOOK1: First Moab overlook, partial view of Israel, altars on near ridge and prevailing wind from right.

locations.OVERLOOK3: Third overlook opening toward entire camp, bare rock and open horizon, king behind prophet.
locations.ROAD_MOAB: Descent from Moab heights, roadside rest place where envoy can speak privately.

locations.MIDIAN: Later Midianite camp, new tent pattern and rock profile establish location and time change; eastern road visible.

lighting.D1: Warm morning sun from screen left at a low angle, soft earth bounce on right cheek, gentle atmospheric depth. Keep shadow direction constant within scene.
lighting.D2: Bright overcast or softened high daylight, restrained contrast, neutral earth bounce, no drifting exposure or pulsing shadows.
lighting.D3: Late sunlight from screen right and behind, amber rim along hair and cloth, cooler open-sky fill on face, practical flames only when shown.
lighting.I1: Oil lamp motivated warm key from the visible table lamp at screen left, weak blue exterior fill at door, soft falloff into room. Expose faces consistently.
lighting.I2: Rainy daytime interior, broad cool doorway key, low warm lamp fill. Repaired roof stays dry inside.
lighting.I3: Shaded hall or chamber, broad doorway side light and warm practical torch fill. Keep flames behind speaking faces.
lighting.N1: Night interior, low steady oil lamp at table, faint cool doorway fill. Dark room remains readable through warm edge separation.
lighting.N2: Moonlit exterior, slate-blue sky fill and small amber lamp near face where present. Local lamp shadows follow its actual location.
lighting.A1: Pale dawn, soft cool river fill, first warm edge light above horizon. Fade lamp contribution as daylight strengthens.
lighting.C1: Cold winter daylight, diffuse silver-blue sky, muted earth palette, visible wet cloth, restrained breath condensation.
lighting.F1: Fire-lit street, orange workshop fire motivates back and side light, gray-blue smoke fill, lamp adds small amber foreground pool.
lighting.F2: Open square beyond fire, smoke softened warm edge light, cool open-sky face fill, distant fire kept behind safe area.
lighting.R1: Overcast flood light, gray-brown water, soft sky reflection, stable exposure and physically consistent debris flow.
lighting.T1: Evening feast courtyard, fixed amber lamps on posts and tables, warm faces against dark background, shrine lamps deeper in frame.

cameras.WIDE_LOCK: Wide establishing view, about 28mm full-frame equivalent, tripod still, broad depth of field. Keep horizon and geographic landmarks fixed.
cameras.INSERT_LOCK: Tight prop insert, about 85mm equivalent, tripod still. Moderate depth of field keeps the interacting fingers and prop legible.
cameras.MEDIUM_LOCK: Eye-level waist-up medium shot, about 50mm equivalent, tripod still. Keep hands readable where the action needs them.
cameras.CLOSE_LOCK: Eye-level close-up, about 85mm equivalent, tripod still. Focus on nearest eye and keep nose and lips within acceptable focus.
cameras.TWO_LOCK: Eye-level two-shot, about 50mm equivalent, both faces on a shared focal plane. Keep established left/right positions.
cameras.OVER_LOCK: Over-shoulder composition, about 50mm equivalent. Foreground shoulder soft, principal subject and relevant landmark clear. Stay on the established side of the axis.
cameras.WIDE_TRACK: Wide lateral tracking view, about 35mm equivalent. Travel parallel to movement at walking pace, ease to a stop before the final pose.
cameras.MEDIUM_TRACK: Waist-up lateral tracking view, about 50mm equivalent. Follow at the subject's pace and settle into the final composition.
cameras.WIDE_PULL: Begin wide, about 35mm equivalent. Pull back slowly to reveal the foreground observer, keep the distant subject readable, and stop for the final beat.
cameras.MATCH_LOCK: Locked composition designed for a match cut between separately generated states. Align horizon, prop scale and eyeline in the edit. Each state is a separate source take.
cameras.VISION_LOCK: Locked image of the specified subject, about 50mm equivalent. Use separately generated plates for the vision and waking world; bridge them in the edit.
cameras.POV_LOCK: Stationary subject-eye-level viewpoint, about 35mm equivalent. Match the approach direction established in the preceding shot.

GOD: same close calm actor throughout; clean steady speech, ordinary room perspective, no cavern echo
ADVERSARY: same performer and acoustic perspective as GOD; convincing reasoning, no sinister filter
DONKEY_VOICE: plain adult speech, dry and direct; jaw animation tested specifically on muzzle
